notes: The negative לֹא is taken as the determiner *no* on *favor* (rule 15's recasting of a clause negation onto a nominal) rather than as an unrepresented morpheme.
עֶרְוַת דָּבָר read as an attributive construct rendering *unseemly thing* (rule 28), with the supplied determiner *some* joining the noun of the expression (rule 15).
The apodosis opens with its own waw, so that waw carries the frame's *that* and הָיָה keeps only *it shall be* (rule 45); the opening וְהָיָה waw takes the resumptive *then* (rule 14).
*it* in *give it in her hand* is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).
